_metadata.what: Record ids that CHANGED identity between dumps, and where the human verdicts recorded against the old id must follow.
_metadata.why: An id here is derived from a title by slugify(). When an adapter repairs a title the slug moves, and every attributed verdict keyed on the old id silently stops matching anything. On 2026-08-22 that orphaned two of Pip Foweraker's accepts and moved the reviewed count from 518 to 516 with nothing going red. See pdoom-data#95.
_metadata.nature: CURATED. Each entry asserts that two ids name the SAME REAL THING. That is a judgement about identity and it carries evidence, a decider and a date. It is not derivable from the data -- if it were, the ids would not have diverged.
_metadata.not_for: Records that genuinely left upstream. A model dropped from the Epoch dataset is an absence, not a rename, and must NOT be given an entry here to keep a count up.

migrations.reason: to_ascii deleted the interpunct in 'DALL(U+00B7)E 2'. Before the 2026-08-22 encoding fix the character had already been mojibaked to the letter 'A', giving 'DALLAE 2'; after it, the character was dropped entirely, giving 'DALLE 2'. Two different corruptions of one name.
migrations.carries: 1 accept by Pip Foweraker, 2026-07-26T10:45:53.148Z, in human_review_2026-07-26.json
migrations.confidence: high -- both titles are corruptions of the same upstream row, matched on the row's other fields, not on the name alone

migrations.reason: to_ascii deleted a Greek letter from 'PanGu-<greek>'. Before the encoding fix it had been mojibaked to the letter 'I', giving 'PanGu-I'; after it, the letter was dropped, giving the dangling title 'PanGu-'.
migrations.carries: 1 accept by Pip Foweraker, 2026-07-26T10:47:03.864Z, in human_review_2026-07-26.json
migrations.confidence: high for the identity, LOW for the title. Which Greek letter it was is NOT established here and is deliberately not guessed -- both dumps are ASCII-coerced, so the character is not recoverable from anything in this repository. 'epoch_ai:pangu' is itself a damaged id and will move again when a fetch runs with the repaired map. That is what this file and the gate exist to survive.
